evidence: The student uses `left++` and `right--` instead of `left = mid + 1` and `right = mid - 1`, only moving the boundary by 1 position instead of past mid.
This means the mid element itself is not properly eliminated from the search space, as `left++` only advances past one element rather than past the already-checked `mid`.
The time complexity degrades from O(log n) to O(n) because only one element is removed per iteration instead of half the search space.
data.invariant: Each iteration of binary search must eliminate at least half of the remaining search space by setting the boundary to mid ± 1, not by incrementing/decrementing by 1.
